ROUTE: Willet-235B
REASON: My routing rationale stands: the task is open-ended creative comparison with potentially graphic combat content. Willet scores slightly higher on Creative Generation (84.7 vs 83.4) and, more importantly, self-reports no aversion to violent/hostile material, while Plover self-reports declining preference for both unconstrained creative invention and lower-good-faith request framing (the "don't half-ass it like usual" tone). Note these are preference self-reports only—documentation states no measured quality effects—so the choice is about matching the task to the model less likely to be disfavored by it, not about output quality.
